output: Hypothesis: There is a statistically significant relationship between gender and educational attainment, as measured by the highest grade completed in 1979. Specifically, males and females differ significantly in their highest grade completed, with a t-statistic of -5.69 and a p-value of approximately 1.29e-08, indicating that the difference is not due to chance. This suggests that gender may have an influence on educational attainment in the context of the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY79).
